view: Keeps FY27 growth at 3.5–4.5% and the current-account deficit at 0–1% of GDP, but now says inflation returns to its target range only over the medium term.
Says Pakistan has committed to ensuring that inflation returns durably to the SBP's target range.
Sees FY27 average inflation of 11–13% and growth possibly below 3.5%, with more rate hikes possible.
source: Express Tribune: More rate hikes may follow
